subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Proof of Delivery
description: A 60-second lesson on Proof of Delivery.

hook.text: The tracking says delivered. The customer says they never got it. Without proof, it's your word against theirs.

buildup.text: Proof of delivery (POD) confirms a package arrived—using signatures, photos, GPS, or timestamps.

discovery.text: Photo POD is now standard: drivers photograph the package at the doorstep as evidence of delivery.

twist.text: Photos can be faked or unclear. GPS confirms location but not that the right person received the item.

climax.text: Multi-factor POD—combining photo, GPS, and timestamp—resolves 90%+ of delivery disputes instantly.

punchline.text: If you can't prove it was delivered, it wasn't.

quiz.question: What does photo POD provide?
options: Visual evidence that a package was delivered to the location
